Description

The Strategic Account Manager will drive sales across the DACH region and own a quota within the assigned geography. This role combines direct business development with channel-led growth, building strong relationships with prospective customers and with MSP, MSSP, and VAR partners.

Cynet is a leading XDR provider on a mission to deliver an all-in-one cybersecurity solution for mid-market and small organizations, as well as managed service providers. The Strategic Account Manager will be a critical contributor to strategic growth, market development, and pipeline creation, while identifying emerging trends across the regionץ

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is €75,000 annually plus commissions. Actual compensation will depend on several factors, including location, level of seniority and skills.

What will you do

  • Partner with Sales Leadership to build and execute a territory strategy that includes hunting for direct business and supporting the Account Executive in the region.
  • Use leading sales and prospecting tools to increase Cynet's market penetration across DACH and other assigned territories if applicable.
  • Create direct demand for the Cynet platform through disciplined outbound prospecting and pipeline-generation activities.
  • Leverage channel relationships to identify, develop, and expand opportunities throughout the region.
  • Lead initial prospect and partner conversations to generate interest, qualify opportunities, and build pipeline.

  • Maintain accurate weekly forecasts and provide clear visibility into quarterly and full-year territory performance.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of successful sales experience with a proven history of performance.
  • Native or fluent German and English language skills.
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota and closing business.
  • Experience selling cybersecurity solutions to end-user customers through channel partners.
  • Experience and proven success in recruiting, onboarding, enabling, and growing channel partners within the region.
  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, listening, and strong presentation skills.
  • The ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and manage time in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience working in a startup or early-stage company.
  • An entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset with strong personal accountability.

Cynet is a leader in threat detection and response, designed to simplify security for organizations of all sizes. Our mission is to empower lean security teams and their partners with an AI-powered, unified platform that autonomously detects, protects, and responds to threats - backed by 24×7 security experts.

jobs.description:
Position Title: Online Adjunct Instructor for EDUC 829CR: Therapeutic Play Techniques for Child Life Specialists

Division: Graduate School of Education

Course: EDUC 829CR: Therapeutic Play Techniques for Child Life Specialists (3 credits)

Term: Spring 2027, Online

Dates: January 19, 2027 – May 4, 2027

  • 1/25, 2/8, 2/16 (Tuesday), 2/22, 3/8, 3/15 (optional), 4/5, 4/12 (optional), 5/3
  • This course is scheduled to run Mondays 7:00 – 9:00 pm, online. Day and time are subject to change

Course Description:

Students will explore the meanings and purposes of play and how play develops as a child develops. Various theories of play therapy will be introduced and the roles of child life specialist and play specialist will be delineated. Students will learn how child life specialists can create the optimal environment to encourage learning, development and healing through play in hospitals and other healthcare settings. The course also covers directive and nondirective therapeutic play techniques for use in playrooms, clinical settings, and at the bedside, both with the individual child and with groups. This course is for Child Life students only.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver course content and materials aligned with the program curriculum.
  • Grade and evaluate student performance in a timely manner, providing constructive feedback.
  • Maintain open communication with students, including scheduled office hours or availability for consultation.
  • Submit final grades and required course documentation (e.g., attendance records) by institutional deadlines.
  • Collaborate with program faculty on course coordination and attend relevant program meetings, if necessary.

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in child life required. Doctorate preferred.
  • Must be a Certified Child Life Specialist (CCLS).
  • 5 or more years of experience as a child life practitioner.
  • Experience teaching at the graduate level, preferred.
  • Experience teaching online, preferred.

Compensation:

  • $1,270

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Principal Quality Engineer carries out procedures to ensure that all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Principal Quality Engineer carries out procedures to ensure that all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements. The Principal Quality Engineer provides strategic advice and guidance to functional team(s). Highly skilled with broad, advanced technical experience.

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.


The Principal, Quality Engineering is a senior individual contributor and hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing modern, AI-focused quality engineering practices across Humana’s software delivery ecosystem. This role defines, demonstrates, and scales what good looks like for enterprise quality engineering across the SDLC through technical expertise, reference patterns, automation frameworks, quality intelligence, and practical implementation guidance.


This role serves as a deeply technical expert in AI-enabled quality engineering, test automation, quality architecture, engineering excellence, and continuous quality practices. The Principal partners closely with the core EQE Platform team, Quality Engineering Segements, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise Engineering Enablement, Agile teams, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Data/AI teams to embed scalable, secure, measurable quality practices into delivery workflows, release processes, engineering platforms, and operational support models.


This is a hands-on principal role, not a people management role. The Principal will accelerate Humana’s enterprise quality engineering transformation by building reusable solutions, creating technical standards and exemplars, coaching teams directly, and ensuring responsible use of AI across quality engineering processes. This role is also responsible for defining and operationalizing what good looks like for EQE across the SDLC, including test strategies and approaches, release management, incident tracking, production validation, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Engineering Strategy, Standards, and Technical Leadership

  • Define, refine, and operationalize enterprise quality engineering standards, patterns, reference architectures, and technical guidance across software delivery teams.
  • Define and continuously evolve what good looks like for Enterprise Quality Engineering across the full SDLC, including planning, development, testing, release, deployment, production validation, support, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish practical, reusable best practices for embedding quality engineering into each SDLC phase, including requirements quality, test planning, test design, automation strategy, validation, release readiness, production verification, and supportability.
  • Create and maintain reusable frameworks, starter kits, accelerators, example implementations, and practical guidance for quality planning, test automation, regression strategy, API and UI testing, service virtualization, code quality, deployment validation, performance and resilience testing, release readiness, observability-driven quality, production validation, and AI-assisted quality engineering.
  • Define enterprise quality expectations, guardrails, and example patterns that help teams consistently apply EQE best practices within Agile, DevOps, and platform-based delivery models.
  • Create technical guidance for quality-related Definition of Done expectations and quality checkpoints across delivery workflows to improve consistency, traceability, and readiness.
  • Provide deep technical consultation to engineering teams on implementing modern quality engineering practices aligned with enterprise delivery models, DevOps controls, and platform standards.
  • Partner with engineering enablement and platform teams to ensure quality practices are reflected in enterprise tooling, templates, reusable workflows, and CI/CD pipeline patterns.

Hands-On AI-Focused Quality Engineering

  • Lead the practical application of AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities across the SDLC through hands-on experimentation, prototyping, implementation, and refinement.
  • Design and implement patterns for responsible use of AI in quality engineering, including test case generation, test data analysis, requirements analysis, defect clustering and triage, risk-based testing, code review support, automation acceleration, quality intelligence, and production issue analysis.
  • Evaluate and pilot generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and analytics solutions that improve test effectiveness, speed, coverage, defect prevention, and engineering productivity.
  • Develop guardrails, technical recommendations, and implementation patterns for safe and responsible use of AI-enabled engineering tools in partnership with Data/AI, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders.
  • Build proof of concepts, reference implementations, and engineering patterns that demonstrate measurable value from AI-enabled quality practices.
  • Help teams integrate AI-assisted workflows into daily engineering practices while preserving human oversight, traceability, quality, and compliance expectations.

Test Automation, Quality Architecture, and Engineering Excellence

  • Define what good looks like for test strategies and test approaches across product, platform, integration, API, UI, data, performance, resilience, security-aligned, and operational validation scenarios.
  • Establish enterprise guidance for selecting appropriate test levels, test types, coverage models, and automation approaches based on risk, architecture, criticality, and delivery context.
  • Create patterns for modern test strategy development that incorporate risk-based testing, non-functional validation, test data management, and environment strategy.
  • Standardize quality engineering approaches for unit, integration, system, acceptance, migration, infrastructure, data, and deployment validation testing to improve consistency and delivery confidence.
  • Define measurable expectations for automation maintainability, reliability, execution efficiency, evidence quality, and test coverage effectiveness.
  • Design scalable approaches for validating APIs, services, event-driven systems, data workflows, web applications, and platform integrations.
  • Establish automation patterns that support shift-left and shift-right quality practices, including pre-merge validation, deployment validation, synthetic testing, and production verification.
  • Promote engineering practices that strengthen quality outcomes, including clean code practices, atomic commits, meaningful pull requests, code quality controls, and automated quality gates.

Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Quality Maturity

  • Contribute deep technical expertise to enterprise Quality Engineering governance frameworks, standards adoption models, and maturity assessments.
  • Define what good looks like for EQE controls and evidence across SDLC governance requirements, including traceability, standards adherence, test management, quality metrics, release readiness, and production validation support.
  • Translate enterprise SDLC standards and governance expectations into actionable quality engineering practices that teams can implement consistently and with minimal friction.
  • Help define maturity criteria for SDLC quality adoption, release quality discipline, incident learning integration, and test strategy effectiveness across teams.
  • Define measurable quality criteria, engineering controls, and evidence expectations aligned with SDLC governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, and AI governance stakeholders to ensure quality engineering practices align with enterprise policies, control expectations, and responsible AI principles.
  • Identify quality, control, and process risks in software delivery workflows and recommend pragmatic improvements that reduce friction while strengthening compliance.

Quality Intelligence, Metrics, and Insight

  • Define and implement actionable quality metrics and telemetry that help teams improve engineering quality, delivery confidence, release readiness, and production outcomes.
  • Define measurable indicators for what good looks like across SDLC quality adoption, release quality, incident quality signals, defect escape trends, and test strategy effectiveness.
  • Establish dashboards and scorecards that help teams assess adherence to EQE best practices in areas such as test planning, release readiness, incident learning, automation effectiveness, and quality outcomes.
  • Partner with platform, DevOps, engineering, and data teams to create dashboards and scorecards for automation coverage, defect trends, test reliability, release quality, deployment validation, code quality, pipeline health, DORA-aligned indicators, and AI-enabled quality outcomes.
  • Use quality, release, and incident data to identify systemic issues, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across teams and platforms.
  • Translate engineering and quality signals into recommendations that improve reliability, maintainability, speed, and production performance.

Enablement, Coaching, and Enterprise Influence

  • Provide expert-level coaching and hands-on guidance to engineering and quality teams adopting modern and AI-enabled quality engineering practices.
  • Create technical playbooks, exemplars, implementation guides, workshops, and enablement content to improve enterprise quality capability.
  • Lead or contribute to Communities of Practice, architecture reviews, innovation forums, and technical learning sessions focused on quality engineering, SDLC excellence, release quality, and AI fluency.
  • Influence senior engineers, architects, and delivery teams across a matrixed environment through technical credibility, practical delivery experience, and clear demonstrations of value.
  • Help teams reduce developer overhead by simplifying quality workflows, improving developer experience, and increasing automation effectiveness.

Platform and Tooling Alignment

  • Guide quality engineering implementation across enterprise platforms and tools used for source control, CI/CD, code quality, release orchestration, feature management, and test automation.
  • Support adoption of pipeline-as-code, reusable workflows, and automation patterns aligned with enterprise platform standards.
  • Advise teams on quality-related usage of tools such as Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, and other approved engineering tools.
  • Ensure quality engineering practices align with enterprise tool strategy and help reduce unnecessary tool sprawl, platform debt, and delivery friction.
  • Partner with platform teams to support scalable onboarding, standardization, and developer self-service.

Audit and Control Support

  • Provide technical support for internal and external audits related to SDLC, quality engineering controls, automation, traceability, release evidence, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Help define repeatable evidence approaches for quality-related controls, including automated evidence collection where appropriate.
  • Partner with Audit, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and platform teams to improve audit readiness and sustainable control adoption.
  • Identify recurring evidence gaps, control weaknesses, quality risks, and AI-related considerations, then recommend practical remediation patterns.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in quality engineering, software engineering, SDET, test automation, DevOps, software delivery, or related technical disciplines.
  • Deep technical hands-on expertise in quality engineering practices, including test automation, quality architecture, regression strategy, API testing, code quality, deployment validation, performance testing, defect prevention, release validation, incident-informed quality improvement, and production quality verification.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and improving scalable automation frameworks, test tooling, quality accelerators, or reusable engineering solutions.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience applying AI-enabled capabilities in software engineering or quality engineering, such as test generation, defect analysis, requirements analysis, quality intelligence, or engineering productivity improvement.
  • Experience defining what good looks like for quality engineering practices across the SDLC, including test strategy, release management, incident tracking, and production quality feedback loops.
  • Experience integrating quality practices into Agile delivery models, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps workflows.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, clean code practices, source control hygiene, pull request quality, and automation-first delivery practices.
  • Experience defining or influencing technical standards, engineering best practices, or SDLC quality patterns across multiple teams.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, DevOps, and Data/AI teams.
  • Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and translate complex quality engineering concepts into pragmatic implementation guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience serving in a principal, architect, staff, or senior lead-level technical role in quality engineering or software engineering.
  • Experience with generative AI, machine learning, LLM-assisted engineering tools, or intelligent automation applied to testing and quality workflows.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, pipeline-as-code patterns, reusable CI/CD workflows, feature flags, and code quality tooling.
  • Experience improving quality through engineering metrics such as DORA, pipeline health, release quality, defect escape trends, incident patterns, test reliability, and AI productivity indicators.
  • Experience implementing or advising on SDLC governance, evidence collection, audit support, control mapping, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Experience creating reference architectures, proof of concepts, technical playbooks, Communities of Practice content, or engineering enablement materials.
  • Experience using platform and workflow standards to reduce developer overhead and improve delivery consistency at enterprise scale.


Use your skills to make an impact

jobs.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a National Program Director, Community Health Centers to join our team.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and execute Labcorp's national strategy and value proposition for Community Health Centers, HCCNs, and Primary Care Associations.
  • Build and manage strategic partnerships with national HCCNs to advance contractual relationships and drive collaborative growth initiatives.
  • Serve on NACHC Strategic Alliance team, leading workflow for member Best Practices and Toolkit development.
  • Standardize and scale CHC services and programs across all operating Divisions.
  • Lead development and commercialization of products, programs, and solutions that improve UDS and VBC quality measures, operational performance, and patient outcomes.
  • Define Community Health Center pricing strategies and build consistency in how we approach uninsured populations and flat-rate programs.
  • Ensure CHC requirements are incorporated into specialty-testing and value-based care initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Diagnostic Assistant, Insight Analytics, and data teams to enhance customer offerings and drive utilization.
  • Partner with Divisional sales and leadership to support CHC growth and retention.
  • Drive internal alignment on CHC strategy and lead cross-functional teams in launching and scaling new programs and solutions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for customer presentations, leadership discussions, and sales strategy
  • Develop a centralized capability for CHC RFP responses and enable Primary Care Association engagement, and value-based care contracting.
  • Drive sales team communications, training, tools, and support resources.
  • Lead targeting campaigns and sales enablement programs.
  • Leverage laboratory data to support UDS quality measures, care gap initiatives, population health programs, and value-based care performance.
  • Lead Salesforce account hierarchy and data governance for CHCs, improve targeting and reporting.
  • Drive customer-facing communications in partnership with Marketing, including sales collateral, marketing campaigns, thought leadership, and CHC conference strategy and support.
  • Monitor CHC segment performance through revenue, accession volume, and customer analytics.
  • Present strategic updates, KPIs and market insights to senior leadership.
  • Participate in business reviews with Divisional and national commercial leadership.
  • Support commercial efforts to achieve annual CHC growth budget.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8+ years’ experience in healthcare, laboratory services, public health, product management.

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience working in lab services
  • Product/Program Director experience in healthcare
  • Laboratory, healthcare product sales or program management experience
  • Experience with Community Health Centers (FQHCs) or large provider organizations
  • Demonstrated ability to take a concept from inception to execution into the market
  • Excellent communication skills with examples – marketing communications experience or advanced degree a plus
  • Broad skill set with ability to think strategically (write a plan) and executive tactically (project management). Quantitative and communication skills are also critical for success
  • Experience working with Community Health Centers, large provider networks, public health organizations.
  • Strong understanding of Community Health Centers, laboratory testing, population health, and value-based care models.

About the Role

The National Program Director of Community Health Centers is responsible for leading Labcorp’s commercial execution for Community Health Centers (CHCs), working with cross functional teams to drive product development, supporting divisional sales success, and building strategic partnerships with national Health Center Controlled Networks (HCCNs). This role has primary responsibility for CHC national strategy, value proposition development, performance tracking, product and program implementation, pricing models, data and analytics solutions, industry partnerships, and sales enablement.

The National Program Director of Community Health Centers serves as Labcorp’s primary internal and external advocate for Community Health Centers, mobilizing cross-functional teams across Sales, Managed Care, Marketing, IT, Legal, and Medical and Scientific Affairs to accelerate growth and strengthen Labcorp’s market position.

The National Director of Community Health Centers reports to the Vice President of Physician Systems within the National HHS Team.

Application window open through: 12/2/2026

jobs.description:
This a Philippine-based position;

NOT a US based position and the pay rate is not in US currency.

About Enterprise Management Solutions

Enterprise Management Solutions LLC (EMS) is a U.S.-based business management and operations firm providing staffing, leadership, and sales infrastructure to partner companies in service industries such as logistics, construction, and transportation.

We are seeking a Moving Services Sales Consultant (Closer) to support one of our U.S.-based moving and relocation service clients.

This role focuses on converting warm leads into confirmed moving and storage service contracts.

Position Overview

The Moving Services Sales Consultant is responsible for managing inbound leads, providing accurate quotes, explaining service packages, and closing contracts for residential and commercial moves.

You’ll engage with customers by phone and email, assess their moving needs, explain the value of the services offered, and guide them through the booking process until their move is confirmed.

Your role is to turn leads into scheduled moves through excellent communication, attention to detail, and consistent follow-up.

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employer: Enterprise Management Solutions LLC (EMS)

Reports To: Chief Marketing & Sales Officer

Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Night Shift PH Time)

Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote – Independent Contractor

Key Responsibilities

  • Contact and follow up with inbound leads from marketing campaigns and referrals.
  • Conduct needs assessments to determine the scope of moves (local, long-distance, or commercial).
  • Present service options, pricing, and timelines based on client requirements.
  • Negotiate and close contracts following company guidelines.
  • Accurately enter details and updates into CRM and scheduling systems.
  • Maintain a consistent follow-up pipeline to ensure lead conversion.
  • Work closely with operations and dispatch teams to ensure smooth handoffs after booking.
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly closing targets for new move bookings.

Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • 2+ years in sales or customer acquisition (preferred industries: moving, logistics, transportation, or home services).
  • Skills:
    • Excellent English communication (spoken and written).
    • Consultative sales ability with a focus on understanding customer needs.
    • Organized and efficient in managing multiple leads and follow-ups.
    • Proficient with CRM and quoting/scheduling software.
    • Goal-driven and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Associate degree preferred (Business, Marketing, or related field).
  • Requirements:
    • Reliable laptop/PC, headset, and strong internet connection.
    • Must be available Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.
    • Willing to work U.S. holidays if required (no paid holiday benefit).

Compensation & Terms

  • Base Pay: $7 USD/hour (≈ ₱410 PHP/hour) — approx. $1,120 USD/month (₱65,000 PHP) for 40 hours/week
  • Commission: $40–$100 USD per closed moving contract, depending on distance and contract value
  • Bonuses: Monthly and quarterly bonuses for exceeding booking and revenue goals
  • Benefits: Independent contractor role — no paid holidays or leave; performance incentives apply
  • Payment: Biweekly USD payout via EMS international payroll (Deel)

Performance Metrics (KPIs)

  • Number of confirmed move bookings per month
  • Lead-to-close conversion rate (%)
  • Average revenue per closed contract
  • Accuracy of CRM entries and quoting details
  • Client satisfaction and booking experience feedback

Career Path

This role offers growth opportunities within EMS as part of the expanding operations support team:

  • Senior Moving Services Sales Consultant / Team Lead
  • Account Executive – Moving & Logistics Division
  • Client Development Manager

Why Join EMS

  • Work remotely with a professional U.S.-based management firm.
  • Access warm leads—no cold calling required.
  • Competitive USD pay plus commissions and performance bonuses.
  • Regular weekday schedule aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Clear growth path in the relocation and logistics sector.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your experience in sales, customer service, or logistics to:

line: Moving Services Sales Consultant – Philippines (Operations Division)

Salary: ₱410 PHP/hour
